mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "directory" lists lawyers (all India, or filtered to one city or one practice area). "profile" fetches the full profile for specific lawyer pages. "reference" lists the cities and practice areas available upstream.

city.title: City
city.description: "directory" mode: restrict the listing to one city. Leave blank for all India.

practiceArea.title: Practice area
practiceArea.description: "directory" mode: restrict the listing to one practice area. City and practice area are separate listings upstream -- if you set both, the city wins.

enrichProfiles.title: Also fetch full profiles
enrichProfiles.description: "directory" mode: after listing, fetch each lawyer's full profile too (bar council, courts, languages, specializations). Costs one extra request per lawyer.

profileUrl.title: Lawyer profile URL or slug
profileUrl.description: "profile" mode: a full lawrato.com profile address, or just the slug (e.g. "advocate-sunil-kumar-bakshi").

profileUrls.title: Lawyer profile URLs
profileUrls.description: "profile" mode: several profiles to fetch in one run.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: "directory" mode: max lawyers to list. Pages hold 20 each and are followed automatically until this cap or the end of the listing.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many profile pages to fetch in parallel ("profile" mode, and "directory" mode when full profiles are enabled).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default and recommended -- listing pages are fetched in sequence, and a stable Indian or global residential exit keeps results consistent.
